name: kyw-dev
description: Spec-driven development workflows for durable docs, verified Tasks, and audits.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, implement, deliver, and audit spec-driven work.
interface.longDescription: Provides six explicit workflows to initialize durable truth, author dependency-aware Task sets, implement one Task through repository completion, deliver STANDARD separately with one exact opt-in public-release extension, and independently audit the result.
defaultPrompt: Use $kyw-init to initialize this repository's durable documents.
Use $kyw-task "goal" to author the smallest ready Task set and stop.
Use $kyw-impl 0001 to implement an existing Task through repository completion, then stop.
Use $kyw-deliver 0001 for a completed Task's current STANDARD delivery; $kyw-deliver 0001 --public-release adds npm→tag→Release
Use $kyw-audit 0001 to audit Task 0001 without modifying the repository.
